title: Quarter-rate switching bound
statement: A Boolean function has the quarter-rate switching bound if, for every natural number $N$, every natural number $w>0$, and every Boolean function $f$ on $N$ coordinates that has a DNF or a CNF of width at most $w$, the probability that $f$ fails to switch under restriction parameter $1/(20w)$ after $k$ rounds is at most $(1/4)^k$ for every natural number $k$.
hypotheses_covered: natural number width w with 0 < w
f has DNF width at most w or CNF width at most w
